Talking to friends, family or support groups can also help in sharing the burden and receiving valuable advice. It's important to make decisions that are best for you, even if they're not easy. If you feel overwhelmed or anxious, taking some quiet time alone can help clear your mind and bring focus to the issue. However, if your spouse's actions continue or escalate, it could become dangerous to stay in the relationship. In such cases, separating from your spouse and staying with relatives or friends may be the best option until you can secure permanent housing elsewhere. Additionally, reaching out to local shelters for resources and support specific to your situation can also be beneficial.
